title: Similarity Leakage Guard
intent: Reject outputs retaining excessive source identifiers or verbatim fragments.
problem: Without token and identifier overlap thresholds quarantine suspicious output, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the similarity leakage guard contract.
context: This pattern addresses derived work must remain independently expressed; its concrete control is token and identifier overlap thresholds quarantine suspicious output.
forces: Correctness requires that large verbatim fragments always block publication
Operational pressure can cause: renaming evades a lexical-only detector
solution: Implement token and identifier overlap thresholds quarantine suspicious output. Verify the anchored symbol `LearningSafetyViolation` with `test_scanner_blocks_secret_and_pii_without_returning_source` before reuse.
invariants: large verbatim fragments always block publication
similarity decision is recorded with measured evidence
failure_modes: common framework boilerplate causes a false positive
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `renaming evades a lexical-only detector` and fails closed if the similarity leakage guard evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For similarity leakage guard, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to token and identifier overlap thresholds quarantine suspicious output.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: derived work must remain independently expressed
Do not apply when: direct reuse is authorized and attribution obligations are satisfied
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
applies_when: derived work must remain independently expressed
not_when: direct reuse is authorized and attribution obligations are satisfied
